display.purpose: One per page, as its h1 — dashboard greeting, page titles, onboarding hero.

headline.purpose: Card headings, step titles, a data page's headline sentence.

body.purpose: Descriptions, helper text, metadata. Cap at 65ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrow kickers above card headlines, in the readable accent. One per card.

mono.purpose: All currency, balances, percentages, counters via .num. Numbers only — never prose.

shadows.name: shadow-hover
shadows.value: 0 8px 24px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-accent) 20%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Hovered interactive cards (night theme). Feedback only, never at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-pressed
shadows.value: 0 2px 8px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-accent) 12%, transparent)

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs floating above the page.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Clickable stat tiles: lift 1px with the standalone translate property (the entrance animation owns transform).

motion.name: progress-fill
motion.purpose: Progress bars scale their fill with scaleX from the left; never animate width.

motion.name: fade-content
motion.purpose: Collapsible card content fade on open/close.

motion.name: fade-up-enter
motion.purpose: Section entrance, staggered in 0.06s steps. Disabled under reduced motion, like every animation.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes a sheet; dashboard collapses to one column; header search becomes an icon.

breakpoints.name: touch
breakpoints.purpose: .touch-target grows small controls' tap area to 44×44px without changing their drawn size.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Form submission and primary actions. Near-white on near-black by night (ink on white by day) — neutral authority, never the accent or a fixed blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #eef1f7; color: #060a14; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; height: 32px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; white-space: nowrap; transition: filter 150ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions (Export CSV, Cancel). Transparent; border and label brighten on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #8b93a7; border: 1px solid #1b2334; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; height: 32px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; white-space: nowrap; transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #2d3854; color: #eef1f7; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { color: #808898; opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Accent Outline Button
components.description: Connection actions (Re-sync, Link bank account): accent text, faint accent border that becomes the full accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent-outline { background: transparent; color: #f59e0b; border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.33); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-accent-outline:hover { border-color: #f59e0b; } .ds-btn-accent-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-accent-outline:disabled { border-color: #1b2334; color: #808898; opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Header Icon Button
components.description: 32px bordered icon buttons in the header (theme, privacy, hide cents, search). A switched-on toggle keeps the brighter icon color at rest.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Switch theme"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3a6 6 0 0 0 9 9 9 9 0 1 1-9-9Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #8b93a7; border: 1px solid #1b2334; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { border-color: #2d3854; color: #eef1f7; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Button (Active)
components.description: Sidebar navigation item in its current-page state. Accent tint — signal only.
components.css: .ds-btn-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #1b2334; background: #0d131f; color: #8b93a7; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-nav--active { border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.4); background: rgba(245,158,11,0.1); color: #f59e0b; } .ds-btn-nav:not(.ds-btn-nav--active):hover { border-color: #2d3854; color: #eef1f7; } .ds-btn-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dashboard Card
components.description: Foundational container: border-defined, faint diagonal wash, flat at rest, soft shadow only on hover. Accent eyebrow + optional headline.
components.css: .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f1a2e 0%, #0d131f 58%); border: 1px solid #1b2334; border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; transition: box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(245,158,11,0.2); } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #f59e0b; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-headline { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; color: #eef1f7; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #8b93a7; margin: 0; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Compact metric tile in the dashboard summary row. Clickable tiles lift 1px and light their border on hover.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #0d131f; border: 1px solid #1b2334; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; display: block; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms ease, translate 150ms ease; } .ds-stat-card:hover { border-color: #2d3854; translate: 0 -1px; } .ds-stat-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-stat-title { font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #8b93a7; margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; color: #22c55e; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stat-card:hover { translate: none; } }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input on a raised surface with a 1px border; keyboard focus shows the 2px accent ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" aria-label="Account name" placeholder="Account name">
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; background: #0d131f; border: 1px solid #1b2334; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #eef1f7; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #808898; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #2d3854; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Goal, budget, and contribution-room progress. The fill is drawn with scaleX from the left, clamped to 0–1.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(238,241,247,0.04); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #f59e0b; transform-origin: left; transform: scaleX(var(--progress, 0)); transition: transform 300ms ease; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-progress-fill { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Bloom is a financial record-keeper for quiet, deliberate review. Its interface is built for the person who opens their dashboard to understand their situation — not to be entertained, encouraged, or upsold. The aesthetic is authoritative and calm: deep navy surfaces, a single signal accent, and typographic weight as the primary hierarchy tool. The night ledger is the default; a daytime ledger (the light theme) carries the same structure on pale blue-grey paper, and follows the operating system's preference unless the user picks one.

Every design decision returns to one question: does this help the user see clearly? Surface colors create depth without decoration. The accent lights up active states and section labels — never as background fill, never as celebration. Numbers are always monospaced. Nothing glows, pulses, or animates unless it conveys state.

Users may personalize three things, and only three: the app accent (one of six), and an identity color and emoji for each account and savings goal. Personalization changes *which* signal color or glyph appears — never how much signal there is.

This system explicitly rejects glassmorphism, purple or teal gradients, neon greens as "positive money" signals, confetti animations on milestones, and motivational CTA language. A user with negative net worth should see that number clearly and without drama. The interface neither congratulates nor catastrophizes.
keyCharacteristics: Navy surface ramp (surface-0 → surface-4) for tonal depth, mirrored by a pale daytime ramp in the light theme
One user-chosen signal accent (Signal Amber by default) used for signal only — active states, labels, key highlights
Outfit for all UI copy; JetBrains Mono (`.num`) for every numeric and currency value — both self-hosted
Border-defined cards with 14px radius, 24px padding, and a faint diagonal wash; flat at rest
Motion is structural only — 150–280ms state transitions, all of it disabled under reduced motion

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on ≤10% of any given screen. It is an indicator light, not a brand color. Accent fill on a button or card background breaks the system — whichever of the six accents the user chose.

rules.name: The Token-Only Semantics Rule
rules.body: Money and status colors are always the semantic variables, never hex literals. A hard-coded `#22c55e` is 2.3:1 on a white card. The theme-contrast test enforces 4.5:1 for every semantic token on every text surface in both themes.

rules.name: The Identity Scope Rule
rules.body: Account-type and account identity colors mark *that account*: its badge, avatar, chart series, and its own page header. They never color navigation, global buttons, or structural UI.

rules.name: The Mono Lock Rule
rules.body: Every currency value, balance, percentage, and numeric counter uses JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals. No exceptions. Outfit numerals in financial data produce misaligned columns.

rules.name: The Prose Is Not Data Rule
rules.body: `.num` is for numbers only. Error messages, hints, and sentences are always Outfit — monospace prose reads as a stack trace.

rules.name: The Label Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels appear once per card as the eyebrow. More than one accent eyebrow per card is visual shouting; use Title style in secondary text for a second level.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No shadow on any card, panel, or container at rest. Shadow is feedback (hover, press) or genuine overlay (dialogs) — never a default.

rules.name: The Border-as-Edge Rule
rules.body: Borders are not decorative — they are the only edge definition in a surface-ramp system. Never strip a card border to look cleaner; the card disappears.

dos: **Do** use the accent only for active states, eyebrow labels, focus rings, progress fills, and key numeric highlights — and `--brand-accent-text` whenever it colors text.
**Do** use the semantic variables (`--positive`, `--negative`, `--negative-soft`, `--caution`, `--warning`, `--inactive`) for every money and status color.
**Do** use JetBrains Mono (`.num`) for every currency value, balance, percentage, and numeric counter.
**Do** define depth with surface tokens and 1px borders; let shadow appear only on hover, press, or true overlays.
**Do** put hover states in CSS classes that own both the resting and hovered values, so no inline style overrides them.
**Do** lift hovered elements with `translate`, and draw progress with `scaleX` — never animate `width`, `height`, or margins.
**Do** add `.touch-target` to any control smaller than 44px that isn't in a dense swatch grid.
**Do** include a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` override for every animation and hover transform.
**Do** show negative financial data clearly and without alarm UI. The number is the information.
**Do** keep emoji to the user-chosen identity glyph on an account or savings goal.
**Do** cap prose at 65ch; stat values, tables, and mono data may run wider.
donts: **Don't** use purple, teal, or neon gradients anywhere in the interface.
**Don't** use glassmorphism on cards or panels — the sticky header's translucency is the single exception.
**Don't** add confetti, celebration, or sparkle animations on financial milestones or goal completions.
**Don't** use a fixed blue (or any fixed color) for primary buttons. Primary actions are neutral; the accent is signal.
**Don't** hard-code one theme's hex for a semantic or neutral color — it will fail contrast in the other theme.
**Don't** use illustrated empty states with cartoon characters or mascots.
**Don't** use emoji in system copy: labels, buttons, status indicators, or toast messages.
**Don't** use motivational CTA language ("Boost your savings!"). The interface is neutral on outcomes.
**Don't** put a shadow on a card, panel, or container at rest.
**Don't** place more than one accent eyebrow label inside a single card.
**Don't** render prose in `.num`, or financial numbers in Outfit.
**Don't** set hover styles from JavaScript (`onMouseEnter`) — keyboard users get no equivalent and reduced motion is ignored.
**Don't** strip card borders to appear cleaner.
